contents.text:
Explore the Overworld and enter Remnants structures. Every distinct ruin variant you discover counts once toward expedition progress.

15 discovered variants reveal the Warden of Ages. 30 reveal The Fossil. At 40, The Echo can be traced only after both earlier bosses are defeated.

History Fragments are optional lore collectibles. At night, ordinary ruins can awaken one Ancient descendant; Forgotten Scribes may carry a Fragment.

Boss coordinates are clues, not teleport buttons. Once a threat is unlocked, its surface seal grants access to the underground complex.
